description: This file contains unit tests for the SimpleGrain functionality in an Orleans-based distributed application. It verifies grain activation, method invocation, state persistence, concurrency handling, and constructor behavior using the Xunit testing framework.

classes.name: SimpleGrainTests
classes.description: A test class for verifying basic and advanced functionalities of SimpleGrain in Orleans, including activation, state management, concurrency, and constructor behavior.

methods.name: GetSimpleGrain
methods.description: Retrieves an instance of ISimpleGrain using the GrainFactory with a random grain ID and a specific prefix.

methods.name: SimpleGrainGetGrain
methods.description: Tests the ability to obtain a grain and invoke its GetAxB method asynchronously.

methods.name: SimpleGrainControlFlow
methods.description: Tests sequential setting of grain state and verifies the correctness of the GetAxB computation.

methods.name: SimpleGrainDataFlow
methods.description: Tests concurrent setting of grain state and verifies the correctness of the combined result.

methods.name: GettingGrainWithMultipleConstructorsActivesViaDefaultConstructor
methods.description: Tests grain activation with multiple constructors, currently skipped due to Orleans limitations.
